dialogues.speaker: Takay
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Wavey Bay! Want to give our Seven-Hued Ruins Charge challenge a try? You can start from over here.

dialogues.speaker: Takay
dialogues.text: In my opinion, you've got an even better constitution than most of the young folk in the Collective of Plenty.
